listing.name: Upgraded Rotary Weapons
listing.summary: Replaces vanilla rotary weapons' animations with smoother spin-up and spin-down sequences and enhances the Storm Needler's sound and muzzle flash.

description:
Download

NexusMods mirror

Compatible with Dark.Revenant's

GraphicLib

.Use

Version Checker

to get noticed about any mod update.

This utility mod is pretty straightforward: it only replaces the vanilla rotary weapons' animations with

(imo)

smoother ones that spin-up and down progressively, and rotate faster when using Accelerated Ammo Feeder.

Additionally, the puny vanilla sound and muzzle flash of the Storm Needler have been changed. If you would rather keep the original sound, use

this version of the mod

Take a look:

SpoilerModdedVanilla[close]

Please note that this mods induce a small lag before the weapons start firing to accommodate the spin-up animation.
